actions.label: Request startup tray screenshot and /bugreport

comment.body:
Thanks for reporting the startup tray issue.

To identify whether this is the main PowerToys tray icon or a module-specific icon problem, please provide:
1. A screenshot of the notification area right after PowerToys auto-starts, showing which icon is missing.
2. A short numbered sequence from sign-in to the failure (for example: sign in, wait for startup, open the tray overflow, try to open Settings, etc.).
3. Whether the main PowerToys Settings window can still be opened when the icon is missing, or whether only a specific module icon is absent.
4. A fresh diagnostic ZIP captured immediately after startup by posting a comment that contains `/bugreport`. If neither the tray icon nor Settings can be opened, run `BugReportTool.exe` from the PowerToys installation folder right after reproducing the startup problem and attach the generated ZIP.

Those details will tell us whether the issue belongs to Runner startup, tray rendering, or a specific module.
